workflow.title: Route expense claims: auto-approve small receipted claims, send the rest to Owen
workflow.goal: Read submitted expense claims. Approve automatically claims under 100 that have a receipt (photo). Send every other submitted claim (100 or more, or no receipt) to Owen at owen@evergreenlandscaping.co in one summary email, and record one decision row per submitted claim in the expense-decisions sheet.

assumptions: 'Under 100' means amount < 100; an amount of exactly 100 or more goes to Owen.
'Has a photo' means the expenses row has receipt = true.
Only rows with status 'submitted' are processed.
Amounts are in the same currency and are numbers.
Owen's address is owen@evergreenlandscaping.co, as the person stated.
risks: outbox.send asks a person before dispatch, so the Owen email only goes out after approval.
Auto-approval only records the decision in expense-decisions; it does not change the expenses sheet status or pay anyone.
The 'at' timestamp is filled from the run input; if the reference does not resolve, the at field may be empty.
successCriteria: Every submitted claim gets exactly one row in expense-decisions.
Claims under 100 with a receipt are marked approved; all others are marked waiting for approver.
Owen receives one summary email listing the claims waiting for approver, when there are any.
The sheet audit confirms the appended rows are in the expense-decisions file.
